content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I got a [product_name] from work to use for personal projects, but I'm experiencing connection issues. I can read data from the [product_name], but I'm unable to download programs onto it. Whenever I try, I get a 'transmission error' (COM17 port not available). The only port I can select in the configuration window is COM16. I have already configured the [product_name] with the right settings, matching [article_no] standard in [product_name] software [version_no]. The cable I'm using is a [product_name] cable with a D-sub 9 pin connector, which I use with a serial USB-to-dsub converter on my laptop (ACER Aspire V3571G). Can anyone offer advice? Thank you in advance.
Check out this discussion: Transmission error
Downloading [product_name] [version_no] isn't an option for me. Sorry, that thread doesn't help in my case.

The order number '[article_no]' you mentioned isn't correct. Here are valid order numbers for [article_no]: [product_name] 24 [article_no] [product_name] 12/24RC [article_no] [product_name] Pure 12/24RCo [article_no] [product_name] 24RC [article_no] [product_name] Pure 24RCo [article_no] [product_name] 230RC [article_no] [product_name] Pure 230RCo [article_no] [product_name] 12RCL [article_no] [product_name] 24RCL [article_no] [product_name] 230RCL [article_no] [product_name] 24RCLB11 [article_no] [product_name] 230RCLB11 [article_no]. See this link: [url] If your device is [article_no], then you need to select [article_no].L as your hardware.
I don't want to spend 60 euros on software that only 'might' resolve my issue.
Thank you for pointing that out. However, I've already tried this solution, and unfortunately it didn't resolve the transmission error.

I don't want to pay 60 euros for software that might help. If you have a previous full version of [product_name], you can upgrade for free. Open [product_name], go to Help > Update Center in the menu bar, and follow the instructions.
A video is attached demonstrating the required steps.

Now I have [version_no], but when attempting to download a program to the [product_name], I receive the same error message as in the picture. I can still read from the [product_name], but this erases my program since nothing is stored in the device. Same results as with previous versions, unfortunately.
You need to put your [product_name] into transfer mode. Refer to the manual, chapter 7.2, page 148. Download the manual here: [url]
It's already showing that status on the [product_name] device, as displayed in the attached picture.
The procedure is detailed in the manual. If you get this error, try cycling the power of the device and then reconnecting the cable.

Unfortunately, my issue isn't resolved by following the manual. What I've tried: 1) Power off the device, connect the cable, power on, and the error screen appears as shown earlier. 2) I manually selected settings on the device, but received the same result. No change. It looks like I may need to write the program manually into the device. I suspect the DSUB to USB converter might be causing the problem, though the software still recognizes the COM port. It's quite puzzling.
Hello, I don't think you'll be able to fix this. 1) Cable might be damaged. 2) Are you using a USB-to-RS232 adapter? It's better to try and get a [product_name] USB cable. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to download software to a [product_name] device using [product_name] software ([version_no]), receiving a 'transmission error' relating to unavailable or misconfigured COM ports. While reading from the device works, program downloads consistently fail. Attempts to configure hardware settings, match order numbers, and apply advice from manuals have not led to resolution. The discussion is hampered by the user's reluctance to purchase new software or upgrades for potential fixes.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable software downloads to a [product_name] device using the correct cable and programming software, without encountering COM port errors or having to buy newer software to solve these connection issues.
